rationale: The agent verified the user by email and acted only on that account. It reviewed order details, correctly identified statuses, canceled the two pending orders, and initiated returns for the delivered orders, with accurate refund information directed to the gift card. However, the agent performed order-changing actions (canceling pending orders and initiating returns) without first explicitly stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s confirmation to proceed, as required by policy. While the user expressed a desire to cancel/return all possible orders, the policy demands an explicit confirmation step before writes. Final information given was consistent with tool outputs. Due to missing explicit confirmation before the writes, this interaction does not meet the pass bar.
